thread:
Mia (oncall): Heads up — customer ACME hitting repeated 429s. Dedicated pool redwood-dedicated-us-east-2 isn't scaling up quickly from min=2 during bursts. Ticket attached: https://support.redwood.example/t/12345
Priority-support: Customer reports queueing + intermittent 429s for ~3m during traffic ramp. They've repro'd at ~40 concurrent QPS. Logs attached in ticket.
Mia (oncall): Repro steps they gave:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-dedicated","input":"<long prompt>","timeout":5000}'
# run 40 parallel threads for ~60s
```
Dinesh: Can you paste the autoscaler/controller logs? Also what's the pool config (min/max/warm_pool/headroom)?
Sara: Pool config for that customer: minReplica=2, maxReplica=20, warm_pool=0, headroomPct=15. No quota holds shown on billing side.
Jordan: infra-bot shows a recent burst of attach delays — average instance attach ~160-180s over last 10m. Possible cloud attach throttling or image pull bottleneck.
infra-bot: [auto] InstanceProvisioner: attach_delay 170s (p95), image_pull 22s p95, attach_retries 3 in last 15m.
Mia (oncall): Also seeing a bunch of preflight failures in controller: "preflight probe timeout" then backoff. Paste sample:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z controller: preflight check failed: probe timed out after 30s, retrying in 15s
2026-03-17T14:03:45Z controller: created replica request id=rep-0a3, pending attach
2026-03-17T14:06:17Z controller: attach timeout for rep-0a3, marking Unready
```
Dinesh: That pattern looks like warmup/probe timeouts stacking with slow attach. If warm_pool=0 we don't have pre-warmed instances to hand off. Two levers: increase minReplica temporarily or enable warm_pool>0. Also confirm autoscaler headroom math — if headroomPct is applied after rounding, minReplica might be too small for sudden ramp.
Sara: Reproduced locally with a small load test against staging dedicated pool — same slow ramp where controller waits for full readiness before returning capacity. We have a regression in the readiness probe timeout we rolled last week (change set #5421 touched the preflight probe).
Jordan: Cloud-side checks: no account-level throttles per billing API; but attach API calls were getting 429s from the cloud provider for a short burst (see cloud-agent log excerpt).
infra-bot: [auto] CloudAttachAPI: rate_limit 429 observed 2026-03-17T14:01:58Z -> 14:04:00Z spike.
Priority-support: Customer on the phone, they want ETA. Can we do a quick mitigation?
Mia (oncall): Agreed mitigation plan: 1) bump minReplica=4 for that pool 2) enable warm_pool=2 3) temporarily relax preflight probe timeout from 30s->60s while we roll a fix. I'll apply config change if no objections.
Dinesh: +1 — also open ENG-5555 to track the probe regression root cause and add a test for scaled ramp behavior.
Sara: I'll prepare a quick canary for the probe timeout fix and run synthetic ramp tests.
Jordan: I'll file a cloud ticket re: attach 429s and request soft quota bump/backoff tuning.
Mia (oncall): Applying changes now (will run config patch + force reconcile):
```
kubectl patch pool redwood-dedicated-us-east-2 -p '{"spec":{"minReplica":4,"warm_pool":2,"preflightTimeoutSeconds":60}}'
```
Mia (oncall): Patch applied; watching metrics.
infra-bot: [auto] PoolController: reconcile triggered for redwood-dedicated-us-east-2, requested replicas increased to 4, warm_pool=2.
Dinesh: Watching controller metrics — initial scale actions triggered faster, attach latencies still present but fewer preflight failures thanks to warm_pool.
Priority-support: Customer reports reduced errors after ~5m, but still sees higher latency for first few requests.
Mia (oncall): Noted. We'll keep warm_pool until probe fix is deployed. Sara, any progress on canary?
Sara: Canary running against staging now; initial results: preflight probe change reduces false negatives; scale-up completes ~70s faster in test harness. Will promote to prod after 1h observation.
Jordan: Cloud support acked receipt for attach 429 spike, they recommended smoothing backoff + increasing parallel attach window. I've added that to ENG-5556.
Mia (oncall): Customer on support call confirms 429s mostly gone, queue depth down. I'll mark ticket 12345 as mitigated and leave as open for postmortem and root cause.
Dinesh: Follow-ups: ENG-5555 (probe regression), ENG-5556 (cloud attach backoff tuning), and add an alert for attach_p95 > 120s.
Mia (oncall): Thanks team. Assigning postmortem to Dinesh and Sara. Will update the incident doc. :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Priority-support: Customer update posted.
Mia (oncall): closing slack thread, will track in ticketing.
